Ferr-i. * Full text (40 Ko) * Red and blue only * Red only

   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Ferr. i.]
Eyes shut on account of pain and photophobia ; lids swollen, discharging copious quantities of pus when forcibly opened ; conjunctiva bluish-red and swollen ; skin pale ; nose thick ; eczema of face ; submaxillary and cervical glands swollen and hard ; periostitis of one finger and two toes ; body emaciated ; abdomen large ; no appetite. θ Scrofulous inflammation of eyes.
After suppression of menses, protrusion of eyes, enlargement of thyroid gland, palpitation of heart and excessive nervousness. θ Exophthalmic goitre.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Ferr. i.]
Roaring in ears.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Ferr. i.]
Nose thick. θ Scrofula.
Scrofulous swelling of nose, with ulcers and crusts inside.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Ferr. i.]
Submaxillary and cervical glands swollen and hard. θ Scrofula.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Ferr. i.]
No appetite. θ Scrofula.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Ferr. i.]
Abdomen swollen. θ Scrofula.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Ferr. i.]
Urine dark-colored, depositing a thick, white sediment ; urine scalds.
Albuminuria with œdema of lower extremities was in some cases temporarily relieved, in other cases entirely cured.
Albuminuria ; diabetes.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Ferr. i.]
Gonorrhœa.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Ferr. i.]
Constant bearing down as if something was coming away ; while sitting feels as if pushing something up ; she can touch the cervix uteri.
On standing erect, disagreeable sensation of pressure and protrusion of rectum ; could not walk across room, subject to dysenteric attacks with severe neuralgic and hysteric spasms, constant tenesmus, and white, slimy evacuations every four or five hours ; sympathetic fever, tenderness of abdomen, urine high-colored and scanty, disagreeable and painful pressure high up in rectum ; fundus and os tincæ on a level. θ Retroversion.
Complete prolapsus and inversion of uterus after mechanical replacement.
Uterine displacements, including ante and retroversion and prolapsus.
Amenorrhœa.
Itching and soreness of vulva and vagina ; parts much swollen.
   

COUGH. [27] [Ferr. i.]
Short hacking cough, with yellowish-white, rather thick expectoration, and at times with pains in chest.
Hæmoptysis.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Ferr. i.]
Great debility and emaciation ; in evening chilliness followed by heat and sweat all night ; cough at first dry, later accompanied by greenish, purulent expectoration, containing small, cheesy particles ; oppression of chest ; inclination to lie on back ; sides of chest tympanitic ; under clavicle rales and bronchial breathing. θ Tuberculosis.
Phthisis pulmonalis in subjects of relaxed fibre, especially in third stage.
Bronchorrea and chronic pneumonia.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Ferr. i.]
Chlorosis.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Ferr. i.]
Bronchocele.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Ferr. i.]
Periostitis on one finger and two toes. θ Scrofula.
   

NERVES. [36] [Ferr. i.]
Great weakness.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Ferr. i.]
Body emaciated. θ Scrofula.
Rheumatism without fever.
Scirrhus ; early.
Chlorosis, particularly in scrofulous subjects.
   

SKIN. [46] [Ferr. i.]
Skin pale. θ Scrofula.
